findings.detail: The parser stored the par currency EUR as fair_value_currency even though the source fair value is in the Fair Value dollar column.

rationale: FX02 is a real localized fair_value_currency error. In the raw SOI table, row 1 labels Par separately from Cost and Fair Value, and row 4 places EUR in the Par currency area while Cost and Fair Value are dollar-denominated cells. The observed stored fair_value_currency U_EUR therefore reflects the par currency being mapped into the fair value currency field; the correct fair value currency is USD.
